$schema_doc: Each short video is one object in the shorts[] array. The video file lives in shorts/<source-livestream>/<slug>.mp4 (relative to schedule-tweets root). Each short can be queued to multiple platforms (yt_shorts, ig_reels, x, tiktok, facebook); each platform has its own independent status flow: pending -> posting -> posted -> failed (or 'skip' to never post there). The base 'caption' and 'tags' are the platform-agnostic defaults; platform entries may set 'caption_override' or 'tags_override' for platform-specific tweaks. The 'thumbnail_path' is optional and currently null until thumbnails are generated. The 'source_clip' tracks which source livestream + clip this came from for traceability.
